claims.claim: Apple says iPhone 17 offers up to 30 hours of video playback.
claims.for: Apple’s technical specifications list up to 30 hours of video playback for iPhone 17 Pro Max.
claims.against: No directly contradicting evidence found in the checked source set.

claims.claim: Apple will reach carbon neutrality across its entire footprint by 2030.
claims.for: Apple’s 2030 plan documents a target to become carbon neutral across its entire footprint.
claims.against: Latest independently verified progress data was not found in the sources checked for this snapshot.

claims.claim: Apple says MacBook Air with M4 delivers up to 18 hours of battery life.
claims.for: The current technical specifications list up to 18 hours of video playback for MacBook Air with M4.
claims.against: Battery life varies by configuration and use; the figure is an Apple test maximum.

claims.claim: Apple Intelligence features are available in more than 10 languages.
claims.for: Apple announced additional language support in a product update.
claims.against: The current support page lists 8 supported languages as of this snapshot.

claims.claim: Apple says it will invest $500 billion in US facilities over four years.
claims.for: Apple announced a four-year US investment commitment in a Newsroom release.
claims.against: Multi-year commitment; annual progress is not independently itemized in the checked source set.

claims.claim: Apple’s services business continues to grow year over year.
claims.for: Reported Services net sales were higher than the comparable prior-year quarter.
claims.against: None found in the cited filing; growth is for the reported period only.

claims.claim: Apple says Apple Pay is available in more than 75 markets worldwide.
claims.for: Apple materials list Apple Pay availability across dozens of markets as of this snapshot.
claims.against: Market count changes between snapshots; not independently verified.

claims.claim: Apple says Services set an all-time revenue record in the June quarter.
claims.for: The 10-Q reports record Services net sales for the quarter.
claims.against: Records are company-reported figures for the stated period only.

claims.claim: Apple says Siri requests are always processed entirely on-device.
claims.for: Apple documents on-device processing for many Siri request types.
claims.against: The support page states some requests use Private Cloud Compute, so the blanket claim does not hold.

claims.claim: Apple says all packaging will be fiber-based by the end of 2026.
claims.for: The environmental progress report restates the fiber-based packaging goal.
claims.against: The target date has not yet passed; final figures are not yet published.

claims.claim: Apple says iPhone 16e includes the Apple-designed C1 modem.
claims.for: The Newsroom release and the product specification page name the C1 modem in iPhone 16e.
claims.against: None found in the cited source set.

claims.claim: Apple says notification summaries never change a notification’s meaning.
claims.for: Apple describes summaries as generated from notification content.
claims.against: The support page warns that summaries may contain errors and recommends checking the original notifications.
